sections.Profile:
"Gold Record" and "Top Ten" are electro-mechanical pinball machines released by Chicago Coin Machine Manufacturing Company in 1975. "Gold Record," introduced on April 9, 1975, is a four-player game featuring two flippers, three pop bumpers, three slingshots, five drop targets, two standup targets, and spinning posts. "Top Ten" is the two-player version of "Gold Record," sharing similar features and design elements.
